description: Event logs of a contract over recent blocks (default 1,000, max 5,000), newest first, max 100: block, transaction hash, topics and data. topic0 takes an event signature such as Transfer(address,address,uint256) or a 32-byte hash. Public nodes refuse very large results: narrow the range or add topic0. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: Blocks to search back from the latest (max 5000)

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

topic0.description: Event signature, e.g. Transfer(address,address,uint256), or a 32-byte hash

name: evm_logs
title: Evm Logs
